description: Ventage Jet, based on the SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m ARF (A200, 2.00 m span) with a JetCat P100-RX turbine. EXPERIMENTAL first physics estimate (AV-06), generated by research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py; not flight-identified. Physical mass, aerodynamic, inertia and thrust-line estimates retain the AV-02 geometry.json physical surrogate. The visual aircraft and gear-up collision witnesses use the imported Blender geometry; wheel positions and radii are source-mesh-derived, while gear contact mechanics and actuator/drag values are provisional estimates. Optional main-wheel brakes are assumed installed; this is not a calibrated physical gear or turbine installation. Flaps remain visual-only; gear is retractable_tricycle.

frames.body: simulation body axes FRD about the CG: x forward = -x_aft, y right, z down = -z_up

mean_chord.source: Preserve the checked-in AV-06 v1 serialized reference.mean_chord scalar exactly for trajectory parity. AV-06 coefficient derivation continues to use unrounded geometric S/b = 0.35113750000000005 m, which differs by 0.0000005 m from the serialized value. The explicit serialized scalar preserves the existing output; it is not a measured chord or geometric MAC. Geometric MAC is 0.3625 m; coefficient reference length only.

propulsion.description: JetCat P100-RX (2017 catalog, non-BL) in a fixed thrust tube: ECU throttle map, acceleration/deceleration-limited spool with a governor lag, bench thrust at STP x installed factor, momentum ram drag and inlet normal force at the intakes (physics/turbine.gd, docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md).

idle_rpm.source: JetCat catalog 2017, P100-RX column: idle 44 000 rpm

max_rpm.source: JetCat catalog 2017, P100-RX column: maximum 154 000 rpm

static_thrust.source: T = 100 (n/154000)^3.12 N through the catalog points 2 N at 44k and 100 N at 154k; JetCat P160/P220 ECU fits give exponents 3.14/3.21 (Momin 2022, arXiv 2205.08330); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

mass_flow.source: linear in rpm, identified on a P100 (Many 2021, DGLR 550281), 0.23 kg/s at 154k (catalog); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

fuel_flow.source: linear-in-thrust estimate from the catalog's 80 and 390 ml/min at 0.80 kg/l endpoints; retained for planned AV-10 fuel burn, with no current runtime consumer; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

throttle_map.source: JetCat ECU 'ThrStick Curve' factory 3.0 (thrust follows the stick): n = idle + (max - idle) s^(1/3), measured R2 0.9992 on JetCat ECUs (Momin 2022); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 3

accel_limit.source: dn/dt <= 0.4 n: idle to 95 % thrust in ~3.6 s, within the P100 identified model and bench traces (2-3.6 s) and JetCat PRO specs scaled; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4 (+-40 %)

decel_limit.source: dn/dt >= -0.6 n: 95 % to 5 % thrust in ~1.4 s (spool-down faster than spool-up, P100 identified model); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4 (+-40 %)

governor_tau.source: P100 local small-signal throttle-to-thrust corner near 0.4 Hz in multi-sine tests; tau = 1/(2 pi fc) = 0.398 s, rounded to 0.4 s. Applied as an RPM-governor lag through the assumed static throttle-to-thrust law and P100 thrust-vs-RPM map; not a universal ECU step response (Many et al., DGLR 550281 sec. 3; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4)

installed_factor.source: thrust tube and side intakes: 0.92 of the bare engine (range 0.85-0.97; JetCat: a correctly gapped tube loses 'zero or very small'); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 6

ram_flow.source: mass flow rise with ram pressure at fixed rpm, fitted to a simple turbojet cycle model (9 % thrust lapse at 70 m/s, full power); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 5

ram_jet.source: jet velocity rise V_jet^2 = V_j0^2 + k u^2, k 1 at idle to 3 at maximum, same cycle fit; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 5

rotor_inertia.source: compressor + turbine wheels and shaft of a 97 mm engine (range 2e-5 to 6.25e-5; TUM assumes 6.25e-5); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 7

rotor_sense.source: rotation direction not published by JetCat: clockwise seen from behind assumed; the gyroscopic sign is unverified (docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 7)

thrust_line_offset.source: research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py: nozzle exit on the engine axis (geometry engine_center height, tube exit z 1.1685) relative to the inventory CG; [x_aft, y_right, z_up]

intake_offset.source: research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py: centroid of the two side intake mouths (geometry intake_stations[0]) relative to the CG

landing_gear.description: Retractable tricycle contact geometry follows the user-supplied Blender GearRetract visual animation. Wheel-bottom trajectories and radii are mesh-derived presentation witnesses; contact stiffness, damping, travel limits, rolling/friction parameters, actuator times and incremental drag are estimates, not measured physical strut or aircraft performance data. Optional main-wheel brakes are assumed installed. Nose steering uses the existing rudder-to-nosewheel mix; the SebArt manual specifies a separate steering servo.

position.source: assets/aircraft/avanti-s-a200/blender-geometry.json (SHA-256 7a1c7869f4bc7af692b8cdbf9034651e6b265bc56a6ff5ded1afa10c031abf7d); source gear.wheels contact_model trajectory [x_right,y_up,z_aft] mapped to the AV-02 LE frame [x_aft,y_right,z_up], including wing_forward_shift; visual mesh contact envelope, not a calibrated strut path; down endpoint

stiffness.source: AV09: Σk = inventory mass 11.705089 kg × (0.090 × 240 Hz)²; split by static reaction shares from source-mesh wheelbase and inventory CG; damping ratio 0.30 uses the existing m/3 per-contact loader convention. Estimated numerical contact parameters, not measured struts.

damping.source: AV09: Σk = inventory mass 11.705089 kg × (0.090 × 240 Hz)²; split by static reaction shares from source-mesh wheelbase and inventory CG; damping ratio 0.30 uses the existing m/3 per-contact loader convention. Estimated numerical contact parameters, not measured struts.

max_compression.source: AV09 initial terminal-contact limit for a 1.5 m/s sink qualification case; equivalent compliance threshold, not measured strut travel

max_steering.source: main wheels are unsteered; nose steering uses the existing rudder-to-nosewheel mix

rolling_resistance.source: Provisional smooth-runway rolling coefficient between JSBSim c172x full-size tyre 0.022 and the small-model Stik E2 value 0.04; no Avanti tyre test

side_friction.source: JSBSim c172x static friction coefficient reused by the Stik and P-51 E2 fixtures; no Avanti tyre measurement

peak_slip_angle.source: Provisional 6 degree peak-slip regularization reused by the Stik/P-51 E2 fixtures; no Avanti tyre measurement

breakaway_factor.source: AV09 provisional static-to-rolling resistance ratio; minimum supported factor pending runway-start testing

extension_time.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m assembly manual identifies pneumatic gear and an air valve but gives no cycle time; provisional actuator duration
